notes: New panel theme: OG Widget. A return to the original widget shape - a narrow vertical strip that simply lists the live sensors grouped by hardware, with a label on the left and a value on the right, no gauges or meters. Percent readings…

The OG Widget only ever shows readings the hardware genuinely reports. Every row is driven by the same availability signal System Scan uses, so a sensor the machine does not emit is not rendered at all - it does not appear blank, greyed…
